description:
Hey there! Thanks for visiting the LRN2DIY channel. We're all about videos that help people to do things themselves around the house. Electrical, construction, woodworking, basements, yards, 3D printing and more. Have a look around and thanks for stopping by!

GEAR: Want to see what equipment we use? Head to https://kit.co/nilsynils/my-filming-gear

BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES: 
Do you have a product or service you'd like us to try or include in a video? We'd love to chat. We don't do dedicated review videos because we've found that it's a win-win to incorporate a product or service into a project or skill when it's useful to the viewer. With that in mind, we offer a Sponsored Product Feature (SPF) – If you'd like to have your product or service featured in one of our upcoming videos, whether organically or as a 15-60 second commercial spot, let's talk.

Contact us for more info. Thanks!
#AvantLink
